metadata.title: Regularity of Gaussian processes, metric entropy and the Wills functional
metadata.abstract: We establish exact relations between three quantities: the growth of the Gaussian Wills functional under dilations, the small-scale metric entropy of the index set, and the critical Hölder exponent of the associated isonormal Gaussian process. For every compact Gaussian-bounded set $T$, the Wills growth exponent $\rho(T)$, the entropy exponent $\eta(T)$, and the critical Hölder exponent $\alpha_H(T)$ satisfy \[ \eta(T)=\frac{2\rho(T)}{2-\rho(T)}, \qquad \alpha_H(T) =1-\frac{\eta(T)}{2} =\frac{2-2\rho(T)}{2-\rho(T)}. \] Thus any one of these parameters determines the other two. Our main tools are a Wills-functional analogue of Sudakov's minoration and a complementary upper bound for $W(rT)$ in terms of local Gaussian widths.
